headline: Center-left: AVS presses Conte on the tax on large fortunes; M5S leader says no
summary: AVS pressed Giuseppe Conte to back a tax on large fortunes, while the M5S leader said no. The debate took place at a centre-left event in Rome marking the Greens' fortieth anniversary.
why: A wealth tax would affect high-net-worth individuals and the fiscal outlook. Italian coalition positions influence the government's budget priorities and bond market sentiment.

original_headline: Centrosinistra, pressing di Avs su Conte per la tassa sui grandi patrimoni: no del leader M5S
